d:
Two-time F1 World Champion Mika Häkkinen joins Unnatee Gidithuri to discuss the push to bring the Indian GP back, why he thinks India needs to move fast, and what it’s like mentoring Kush Maini. He also looks back on racing against Michael Schumacher, explains why he walked away from F1 in 2001, and shares his thoughts on 2026 F1 World Champion Kimi Antonelli. Formula 1 race weekends are available to stream live on FanCode.
Editor: Yadnyesh Salunke
